data.name: LocalQrNetworkLimits
data.value: Use a Wi-Fi name without control characters and an 8–63 character ASCII password, or leave the password empty for an open network.

data.name: LocalQrSetupScope
data.value: Stock firmware requires an existing vendor binding token. Patched OpenYI local01/local02 firmware can use a locally generated setup marker. Physical setup with the patched firmware remains experimental.

data.name: Setup.LocalOnly
data.value: OpenYI local01 firmware is required. Choose the Wi-Fi network, show the QR to the camera in setup mode, then connect. No vendor account or pairing ID is needed.

data.name: Setup.ScanInstructions
data.value: Put the camera in QR setup mode and show it this code. After “Wi-Fi connected” and “pairing successful”, find the camera below. You can also save the image and display it on a phone.

data.name: Setup.QrPrivacy
data.value: The QR contains your Wi-Fi credentials. They are kept only on this page unless you save the image.

data.name: Setup.QrSaved
data.value: Setup QR image saved. Display it on your phone for the camera.

data.name: Setup.FoundCameras
data.value: Found {0} camera(s). Choose one, give it a name and connect.

data.name: Setup.NoneFound
data.value: No cameras answered. Wait for Wi-Fi setup to finish and retry, or enter the camera’s LAN address. Your PC and camera must share the local network.

data.name: Setup.Saved
data.value: Camera verified and saved. Its local key is encrypted for this Windows account.

data.name: Setup.MaintenanceScope
data.value: The default works with the tested camera. Change it only if the camera’s maintenance password was changed. Pairing reads the key through the local FTP maintenance interface; this transfer is not encrypted.

data.name: Setup.Canceled
data.value: Setup operation canceled or timed out. You can retry.

data.name: Setup.WaitOrCancel
data.value: Wait for camera setup to finish, or cancel it on the Camera pairing tab.

data.name: Setup.NoSavedCamera
data.value: No camera saved. Use OpenYI firmware setup to add a camera, or import an existing profile below.

data.name: Setup.PcWifiUnavailable
data.value: Windows could not read the current Wi-Fi connection. Enter the network, or use a saved camera’s Wi-Fi.

data.name: Setup.NoPcWifi
data.value: This PC has no active Wi-Fi connection. Enter the network, or use a saved OpenYI camera’s Wi-Fi.

data.name: Setup.WifiPermission
data.value: Windows denied Wi-Fi detection. Allow location access for desktop apps in Windows settings, or enter the network manually.

data.name: Setup.EnterWifiPassword
data.value: Enter the Wi-Fi password, or explicitly select “Network has no password” for an open network.

data.name: Setup.PcWifiLoaded
data.value: Current Wi-Fi details filled in. Check that this network is available on the camera’s supported Wi-Fi band.

data.name: Setup.NoExistingCamera
data.value: No saved camera is available. Detect the PC’s Wi-Fi or enter the network details.

data.name: Setup.CameraWifiLoaded
data.value: Wi-Fi details read directly from the saved OpenYI camera.

data.name: Setup.WifiUnavailable
data.value: The camera’s Wi-Fi settings could not be read unambiguously. Enter them manually.

data.name: Setup.LocalFirmwareRequired
data.value: This camera needs the supported OpenYI local01 firmware before local onboarding. Existing profiles have not been changed.

data.name: Setup.FirmwareMismatch
data.value: The camera’s key-handling software does not match the reviewed OpenYI firmware. No key was imported.

data.name: Setup.InvalidOwnerKey
data.value: The camera’s local owner key is missing or invalid. No profile was replaced.

data.name: Setup.InvalidIdentity
data.value: The camera’s transport identity is missing or ambiguous. No profile was replaced.

data.name: Setup.MaintenancePasswordInvalid
data.value: Enter a valid camera maintenance password.

data.name: Setup.MaintenanceLoginFailed
data.value: Camera maintenance login failed. Check the password under Advanced settings.

data.name: Setup.MaintenanceReadFailed
data.value: Could not read the camera’s local setup files. Check connectivity and firmware compatibility, then retry.
